title: Job: I Have Made a Covenant with My Eyes

questions.question: I have made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I gaze at a what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:1 (ESV): "I have made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I gaze at a virgin?"

questions.question: Does he not see my ways and number all my what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:4 (ESV): "Does he not see my ways and number all my steps?"

questions.question: Let me be weighed in a just balance, and let God know my what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:6 (ESV): "Let me be weighed in a just balance, and let God know my integrity!"

questions.question: If I have walked with what, and my foot has hastened to deceit...
questions.explanation: Job 31:5 (ESV): "If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hastened to deceit;"

questions.question: If my heart has been enticed by a woman, and I have lain in wait at my neighbor's what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:9 (ESV): "If my heart has been enticed by a woman, and I have lain in wait at my neighbor's door,"

questions.question: Did not he who made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:15 (ESV): "Did not he who made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the womb?"

questions.question: If I have withheld anything that the poor desired, or have caused the eyes of whom to fail?
questions.explanation: Job 31:16 (ESV): "If I have withheld anything that the poor desired, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,"

questions.question: If I have made gold my trust or called fine gold my what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:24 (ESV): "If I have made gold my trust or called fine gold my confidence,"

questions.question: If I have rejoiced at the ruin of him who hated me, or exulted when what overtook him?
questions.explanation: Job 31:29 (ESV): "If I have rejoiced at the ruin of him who hated me, or exulted when evil overtook him"

questions.question: Oh, that I had one to hear me! (Here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me!) Oh, that I had the indictment written by my what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:35 (ESV): "Oh, that I had the indictment written by my adversary!"

questions.question: Then let thistles grow instead of wheat, and foul weeds instead of what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:40 (ESV): "let thistles grow instead of wheat, and foul weeds instead of barley."

questions.question: I would bind it on my shoulder; I would bind it on me as a what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:36 (ESV): "Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; I would bind it on me as a crown."

questions.question: If I have eaten its yield without payment and made its owners breathe their what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:39 (ESV): "if I have eaten its yield without payment and made its owners breathe their last,"

questions.question: If I have concealed my transgressions as others do by hiding my iniquity in my what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:33 (ESV): "if I have concealed my transgressions as others do by hiding my iniquity in my bosom,"

questions.question: If my land has cried out against me and its furrows have wept what?
questions.explanation: Job 31:38 (ESV): "If my land has cried out against me and its furrows have wept together,"

key_verse_text: I have made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I gaze at a virgin?
